item.title: [WFLA News Channel 8] Trump coins already out of stock at US Mint
item.description: One dollar gold-colored coins featuring President Trump’s image sold out hours after they were released on Wednesday afternoon, according to the U.S. Mint’s website. The currency, which the Trump administration advertised as an opportunity to “own a piece of American History,” went up for purchase at noon. A 25-coin roll, priced at $61, is “currently [...]

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Dump Duke launches new campaign to switch to municipal-run power
item.description: The debate on whether to keep Duke Energy or switch to city-run power has been ongoing for months in St. Pete.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Private companies set to strike new deals to expand Venezuelan oil production
item.description: The U.S. and Venezuela are moving forward with efforts to expand energy deals, on the heels of an agreement allowing the U.S. to tap into Venezuelan oil.

item.title: [WATCHLIST: county commission] [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] ‘We cannot fight crime in the Stone Age’: Pinellas sheriff defends Flock cameras
item.description: Pinellas County Sheriff Bob Gualtieri is defending Flock and other license plate cameras as important crime-fighting tools, even as a county commissioner pushes to remove them from county roads.

item.title: [FOX 13 Tampa Bay] Billy Adams sentencing: Tampa jury recommends death for unborn child's killing
item.description: A jury recommended Wednesday that Tampa rapper Billy Adams be put to death for the killing of his pregnant girlfriend's unborn child.

item.title: [FOX 13 Tampa Bay] Denmark and Tampa team up to tackle urban challenges
item.description: Tampa and Copenhagen may be nearly 5,000 miles apart. Both are looking for better ways to handle growth, water and transportation challenges.

item.title: [FOX 13 Tampa Bay] Hillsborough County tightens rules on short-term rentals
item.description: Hillsborough County is tightening its rules for short-term rental properties following complaints from neighbors about noise, parking and disruptive guests.

item.title: [FOX 13 Tampa Bay] Tampa Bay restaurants adapt as GLP-1 meds and ‘sober curious’ diners shift habits
item.description: Some Tampa Bay restaurant owners say they are adjusting menus and adding more non-alcoholic options and smaller portions to adapt to changing diner habits.

item.title: [FOX 13 Tampa Bay] FDOT camera ban: Some Tampa Bay agencies defend automated license plate readers
item.description: Some law enforcement leaders across Tampa Bay are defending automated license plate readers after state officials ordered them to be removed from all state highway rights of way.
